name: Convenia
tagline: The operating system for the individual offsite.
positioning: Convenia turns a single professional's need for focused time away into a fully provisioned, itinerary-grade offsite — venue, agenda, and outcomes documented.

hero.h1: Your offsite, provisioned to enterprise standard.
hero.sub: Convenia designs, books, and documents solo and small-team offsites — from the venue contract to the post-session outcomes brief — so a single professional can convene like a whole department.

features.title: Venue procurement, handled
features.description: Submit your dates and objectives. Convenia sources, vets, and books the room, the lodging, and the connectivity against a standardized supplier scorecard.

features.title: Agenda architecture
features.description: Every offsite ships with a time-boxed agenda template — objectives, session blocks, and decision checkpoints — pre-loaded and editable before you arrive.

features.title: Outcomes brief on exit
features.description: Leave with a structured one-page brief: decisions logged, action items assigned to you, and follow-up dates set. No lost momentum on Monday.

features.title: Expense reconciliation
features.description: Consolidated, itemized invoicing formatted for reimbursement or Schedule C. One line item instead of eleven receipts in a drawer.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose a full week planning my own quarterly reset. Convenia procured the venue, framed the agenda, and handed me an outcomes brief before I left the parking lot. It felt like having an operations team.
testimonials.name: Miriam Vasquez-Holt

testimonials.quote: As a solo founder I never got the offsite treatment larger teams take for granted. Convenia standardized the whole thing. My two-person offsite ran with the rigor of a board retreat.
testimonials.name: Daniel Osei

testimonials.quote: The reconciliation feature alone justifies the tier. One itemized invoice, formatted for my accountant, replaced an afternoon of receipt archaeology every quarter.
testimonials.name: Priya Ranganathan

pricing.blurb: For the individual professional running a focused reset.
For solo leaders convening a small team offsite.
For those who convene on a quarterly rhythm.

homepage.footerBlurb: Convenia is the standard for individual and small-team offsites — provisioned, documented, and reconciled to enterprise expectations.
